rubric.role_summary: Senior customer support role serving rental property owners and tenants throughout the lease lifecycle, handling high-volume, multichannel inquiries about payments, ledgers, lease changes, and platform issues.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior customer support role serving rental property owners and tenants throughout the lease lifecycle, handling high-volume, multichannel inquiries about payments, ledgers, lease changes, and platform issues.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 2+ years of experience in customer service, customer support, onboarding, or real estate.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- 2+ years of experience in property management.
- Experience with Hubspot and Appfolio.
- Ability to handle high-volume customer interactions across phone (60%), email, SMS, and ticketing systems (40%).
- Experience using AI to draft responses, identify patterns in customer data, and build efficient workflows.
- Experience with CRMs and Google Suite.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Denver, Colorado area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
